description: Hotspot-steered de-novo nanobody generation against NS1 beta-ladder (RFantibody native flow)
target_complex: NS1 full-length (346 aa), renamed to chain T for HLT format, native numbering 1-346

hotspots_to_steer.description: NS1 residues to engage via interface refinement
hotspots_to_steer.rationale: 269 already engaged (3.9 Å); 272 & 274 nearest unengaged (7.5–7.7 Å), refinable to contact. Excluded: 296 (12.2 Å) and 294 (19.0 Å) — both farther than the selected trio; 294 in particular would require a major loop rearrangement.

approach_note: Original plan was seed-5 partial diffusion, but that requires Chothia renumbering (ANARCI) to build an HLT framework, and ANARCI is not installed in the pinned env. Pivoted to de-novo generation from the standard HLT framework h-NbBCII10, steered to the same missing-anchor hotspot set. This gives up literal reuse of seed 5's backbone coordinates but directly tests whether explicit steering recruits the anchors seed 5 missed.
seed_5_context: Seed 5 (ipTM 0.752, on-epitope, engages hotspot 269 at 3.9 Å) is the evidence that the beta-ladder is engageable and defines which hotspots to steer toward; its coordinates are NOT used as the diffusion scaffold.
framework: h-NbBCII10 (standard HLT nanobody, chain H, CDR-annotated)

downstream.boltz_validation: MSA-backed full-length, follow-up job on top designs

job_status: stopped by user mid-run before completion
